title: Sound Waves
summary: Grade 9: sound as a longitudinal wave, frequency, wavelength and v = fλ, echoes and reverberation, ultrasound and SONAR, and how the human ear works.

ib.statementOfInquiry: Sound is energy carried as a pattern of vibrations; understanding its form lets us make music, design concert halls, see inside the body and protect our hearing.

factual: How are speed, frequency and wavelength related?
What is the range of human hearing?
conceptual: Why does sound travel faster in solids than in air?
How can echoes be used to measure distance?
debatable: Should firecrackers be banned during festivals because of noise pollution?
Should earphones have a legal volume limit?
